input.quote: 13.6 Independent Development: Covenant not to Sue. Nothing in this Agreement will be construed to prohibit either parties' right to independently develop the Developments contemplated above.
input.rationale: No non-compete or competitive-activity covenant binds Corio anywhere in the Agreement. Section 2.7 (p0042) is a conventional license-use/reverse-engineering restriction, and the "Corio Market Segment" (p0013) and "Territory" (p0024) definitions merely scope the licenses granted to us (customers under $1B revenue, North America) rather than prohibit us from operating any business, buying or building competing products, or selling other services; the definition even preserves our right to keep serving customers that grow or are acquired above the threshold. Section 14.8 confirms we solely direct the Corio Services and may subcontract freely, and Section 13.6 (p0117) expressly confirms each party's right to develop independently. This meets the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on the customer), so no redline is required.
